contexts or analysis of

ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
FUN-4.B.1
The derivative can be used to solve optimization
problems; that is, finding a minimum or
maximum value of a function on a given interval.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
FUN-4
A function’s derivative can be used to understand some behaviors of the function.
